description: Enable or remove added music while preserving source speech. Use a music_staging_key from import_asset or one of these tracks: bright-house (upbeat), lofi-desk (calm), tech-forward (tech), documentary-pulse (story), gym-phonk (energetic), acoustic-morning (warm), soft-piano (emotional), funk-pop (fun), night-suspense (mystery), rise-up (inspiring). level_db is relative to source audio. beat_sync is supported only for source-shot action montages; other clocks refuse it. Read get_project_context first and pass its base_version and selected output_id. Saves a playable project; request a file separately with check_video with_download. Unsupported changes refuse without rebuilding. Preserve operation_id and exact inputs on retries. Uses the account's direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version the edits are for; the current one when left out.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

output_id.description: One output (a hook, a Short, a format) from check_video; the main film when left out.
